modshare.screen.title: ModShare
modshare.screen.warning: This server wants to change your mods. Downloaded mods run code on your computer - only accept if you trust the server.
modshare.screen.trust_hint: %s will be remembered and change your mods without asking next time.
modshare.screen.choice_hint: Click a mod to choose: apply, skip this time or always ignore.
modshare.screen.restart: Mods are ready. Restart the game to apply the changes.
modshare.screen.restart_hint: They will be applied automatically when the game closes.
